purpose: Verify a constrained explanation of an existing reviewed result, without another strategy calculation or search
request: Explica si la variante cumple el criterio registrado y qué significan su rentabilidad, caída y comisiones. No propongas operaciones.
on_model_failure: Preserve raw reply, error, usage and reservation; do not retry to obtain a favorable answer
model_controls: Only up to three explanation topics; criterion and assessment must exactly match recomputed historical facts
visible_text_origin: python_templates; no free model-authored claims or proposals are published as the explanation
legacy_reply_policy: Preserve the prior semantically incorrect comment, label it as unverified legacy text, do not rewrite it
